title: Gate Card Fixture
description: A fixture card, written at build time so the gate can read a real one.
It is authored as an ARRAY OF LINES, which `rete build --card-file` joins
with newlines — the shape that makes a Markdown description writable by
hand. Every construct the card viewer supports appears below, so the
renderer is asserted against a real card rather than a synthetic string.
It also holds a <script>window.__cardDescPwned = 1</script> tag, an
link and an & on purpose: card text is third-party data, raw HTML is NOT a
supported description format, and none of it may ever reach the DOM as live
